name: BrandBird
summary: Screenshot editor that turns screenshots into social media graphics with backgrounds, 3D effects, mockups and notes.
description: Upload any screenshot or image and style it in a few clicks: gradient, pattern or photo backgrounds, 3D perspective tilts, device mockups (iPhone, MacBook, iPad, browser frames), shadows, annotations and watermarks. A free template directory holds hundreds of customizable templates by platform, brand kits keep colours, fonts and logos consistent, and companion tools cover carousels, app-store screenshots and OG images. Built for founders, marketers and creators making posts, landing-page visuals and changelogs.
contains: hundreds of free, customizable social media templates across 15+ platforms
3D effects, drop-shadow presets, annotations (arrows, emojis, labels) and device mockups
brand kits: watermarks, logos, colour palettes and fonts
import tweets and web pages directly as screenshots
companion tools: screenshot beautifier, LinkedIn/Instagram carousel generators, App Store and OG image generators
Figma plugin, Chrome extension and Mac app
pricing: Free $0, Pro $15/month, Lifetime $179 one-time, Enterprise on request
